      <h1>Where Does the Bill Get Decided? Cost-Lever Ownership Map</h1>
      <p class="ws-sub">A cost-lever ownership map that says explicitly which spend decisions are engineered centrally and which are left to teams.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="ws-meta">
      <b>WS-19-where-the-bill-gets-decided</b><br>
      Pack C - The case and the money<br>
      fill order <b>5</b> &middot; type <b>decision</b><br>
      audience <b>exec</b>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-source">
    Source: <b>Architectural Patterns: A Rosetta Stone</b>,
    <i>1. The layered model of an agentic runtime</i> &middot;
    <code>handbook\ch19-architectural-patterns-rosetta-stone.qmd</code> L50-50 &middot;
    <a href="https://danielmeppiel.github.io/agentic-sdlc-handbook/handbook/ch19-architectural-patterns-rosetta-stone.html#sec-layered-model">#sec-layered-model</a>
  </div>

  <div class="ws-instruction">
    For each printed cost lever, record who sets it today and what it is set to. Choose who
    should set it, then write the target state and date, the guardrail, the named accountable
    owner, and how a change will be detected and who receives the signal. Tick Gap where
    today's setter and intended setter differ. Map each lever to one spend pool using the
    pool names on the facing WS-07 spend-pool budget model. Have the architecture or platform
    owner sign and date the sheet.
  </div>

          <td class="prior">Dispatch topology at the Execution layer<span class="prior-src">ch19 L50</span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>

          <td class="prior">The model selected at the Foundation layer is the cost function<span class="prior-src">ch19 L50</span></td>
          <td class="prior">The prefix laid out at the Assembly layer decides how much of each turn is cacheable<span class="prior-src">ch19 L50</span></td>
          <td class="prior">The dispatch chosen at the Execution layer governs how many calls happen and on which model class<span class="prior-src">ch19 L50</span></td>
        </tr>
        <tr>
          <td class="ws-num"><span class="fno">3</span></td>
          <td><b>The pattern that engineers it</b></td>
          <td class="prior">Model Router and Gradient Workflow at Dispatch<span class="prior-src">ch19 L50, L113-129</span></td>
          <td class="prior">Cache-Aware Prefix at Assembly<span class="prior-src">ch19 L50, L103-107</span></td>
